sending: Will be sent once the connection is back …
home_empty: You have not joined any channel yet.
community_no_channels: This community has no channels yet.
friends_none: You have no friends yet. Send a request above.
input_placeholder: Write a message – paste or drop an image (Shift+Enter for a new line)
server_input_placeholder: Enter an IRC command, e.g. WHOIS nick, /ns info or /quote …
server_chat_only: This command only works in a channel or conversation.
delete_message_failed: The message could not be deleted.
profile_not_found: There is no profile for this account.
profile_avatar_hint: JPG, PNG or GIF, max. 2 MB. The image is cropped to a square.
profile_avatar_failed: The profile picture could not be saved.
profile_status_failed: The status could not be saved.
highlight_words_hint: Messages containing these words are treated like a mention – for example your character name. Separate several words with commas.
settings_notification_sound_hint: Plays on mentions and highlight words while the channel is not open. Applies to this device.
settings_notify_minimized_hint: Also report regular channel messages while the window is minimised.
settings_browser_notifications_hint: Reports mentions and direct messages while the chat is in the background.
settings_show_join_part_hint: Join, part and quit lines in channels.
connections_error_load: The connections could not be loaded.
connections_error_delete: The connection could not be deleted.
connections_new_home_hint: With your :app account, including communities, friends and profile.
connections_new_directory_hint: Well-known IRC networks with ready-made settings.
connections_new_custom_hint: Set up any IRC network by hand.
connections_login_hint_home: Optional: with SASL you sign in with account name and password instead of the saved login.
connections_login_hint_external: Optional: SASL sign-in if you have a registered account on this server.
connections_reconnect_hint: Changes apply from the next connect.
connections_directory_sync_failed: The directory could not be refreshed.
connections_directory_empty: No servers yet. Refresh the directory.
connections_test_timeout: No answer. Check host, port or firewall.
connections_test_refused: Connection refused. Is the port right?
connections_test_not-found: Host not found. Check the spelling.
connections_test_certificate: Certificate invalid or self-signed. When connecting you can trust it once or permanently.
connections_test_tls: TLS error. Is TLS set correctly for this port?
connections_test_rate_limited: Please wait a moment before testing again.
connection_error_host_invalid: Enter the host name only, without ircs:// or a path.
connection_error_port: The port must be between 1 and 65535.
connection_error_websocket_url: Please enter an address starting with wss:// or ws://.
connection_error_nickname: Invalid nickname (letter first, no spaces, max. 30 characters).
connection_error_channel: Channels start with # and contain no spaces.
connection_error_sasl_password: The password for SASL sign-in is missing.
connection_error_encryption: The password cannot be stored securely on this system.
settings_autojoin_hint: These channels are joined on every connect, in addition to the channels of your last session. Separate several with commas.
settings_ignore_list_hint: Messages from these nicks are hidden. Also via /ignore and /unignore.
settings_rich_presence_hint: Others see in the chat what is playing in the built-in player.
settings_system_media_hint: Also show music from other apps (e.g. Spotify) as status.
settings_logging_enable_hint: Save the messages of this connection as text files on this computer.
settings_connections_hint: Manage profiles, credentials (SASL) and the server list.
settings_spotify_hint: Links Spotify to your :app account so your music can show as your status.
settings_error_report_hint: App errors are only stored on this computer. Copy the report and send it to us when you report a problem – credentials are removed first.
settings_push_hint: Mentions and direct messages arrive even when the chat is closed. Muted channels and ignored users stay silent.
push_registered: Push notifications are active on this device.
push_status_denied_browser: Blocked in the browser – allow it in the site settings
push_status_denied_app: Notifications are turned off for the app
push_status_unsupported_device: This browser does not support push
settings_android_notifications_hint: Direct messages and mentions have their own channels – set each one loud or quiet in the Android settings.
share_file_too_large: :name is too large (15 MB at most) and is not attached.
share_file_unreadable: The file could not be read – the sharing app did not grant access.
settings_quit_message_hint: Others see it when you log out or close the chat. Leave empty for the default text.
settings_quit_message_placeholder: Avoid staring into the cosmic void. It might stare back at you.
quick_switcher_placeholder: Where to? Channel, DM or friend …
invite_link_copy_failed: Could not copy the invite link.
voice_mic_denied: No access to the microphone. Please allow the permission.
voice_mic_denied_system: Windows (or the system) blocks the microphone. Allow access for desktop apps under Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone.
voice_mic_missing: No microphone found. Is one connected and selected under "Microphone"?
voice_mic_busy: The microphone cannot be opened – another app may be using it exclusively.
voice_unreachable: The voice server cannot be reached.
voice_server_disabled: Voice chat is not set up on this server yet.
voice_failed: The voice chat could not connect.
voice_audio_blocked: Audio is blocked – click here to enable it
voice_not_allowed: Voice chat is in testing and not yet enabled for your account.
voice_check_failed: Your nick could not be checked right now. Please try again in a moment.
voice_wrong_account: This nick does not belong to your account.
voice_not_in_channel: You have to be in the channel to join its voice chat.
voice_left_channel: Voice chat ended because you left the channel.
voice_filter_failed: The noise filter could not be loaded, the browser filter is active.
voice_call_leaves_channel: Answering leaves the voice chat in :channel.
voice_call_notification_body: Call in the :app chat. Open the chat to answer.
voice_call_unsupported: :nick cannot take calls with their client. Calls only work in the :app chat (web, desktop, app).
voice_call_unavailable: :nick has voice chat switched off and cannot take calls right now.
settings_voice_enabled_hint: Experimental: a microphone button appears in the channel header. Everyone in the channel can join its voice chat.
settings_voice_ptt_key_hint: Works while the chat window is in the foreground.
settings_voice_noise_hint: Filters of the browser against echo, steady noise and varying volume. Applies from the next join.
settings_voice_sounds_hint: A short sound when someone joins or leaves the voice chat and when you mute or unmute yourself. Plays on the chosen output device.
settings_voice_filter_hint: RNNoise removes keyboard, fan and background noise better than the browser and needs a bit more CPU. Loaded on first use (about 120 KB). Applies from the next join, the mic test uses it right away.
settings_voice_threshold_hint: While speaking the bar should be above the marker, below it in silence. Everything below is not sent.
report_details_placeholder: What happened? Channel and time help us, for example.
report_child_safety_hint: Please do not save or forward any images or content – a note is enough. In an emergency, call 112.
report_error: The report could not be sent. Please try again.
report_error_rate_limited: You just sent several reports. Please wait a few minutes.
always_on_text: Your nick stays online even when the app or browser is closed – so you will not miss any messages. Others will see you as "away".
always_on_change_later: You can change this any time in the settings under "Account".
always_on_setting_hint: Your nick stays in the channels even without a connected device. Messages end up in the history, others see you as "away".
always_on_disabled: Your nick goes offline as soon as no device is connected.
always_on_unavailable: This setting cannot be changed right now. Please try again later.
events_empty: No events in the next 30 days.
report_received: Thank you! We received your report and will review it as soon as possible.
cm_topic_hint: Tip: Ctrl + K inserts an mIRC colour code.
cm_mode_e_hint: +E is treated as a channel mode here. Its meaning depends on the IRC server (Ergo: RPG commands), so the client gives it no fixed meaning.
uploads_intro: Manage your uploads here. “Copy link” puts the URL on the clipboard, “Delete” removes the file and its entry.
